stats.label: Major warships and submarines added since 2020, 19 of them in the last year
Ships in the US fleet, which remains larger by tonnage
Aircraft carriers China is estimated to have by 2035, close to the US fleet of 11

diaspora_bullets: US officials expect Chinese submarines to operate routinely in the Indian Ocean by 2040
On any given day, as many as 100 Chinese navy ships are out on Asia's busiest trade routes
news_summary: China's navy now has a battle force of more than 400 ships and submarines, around 35% larger than the US Navy by hull count, according to official US numbers seen by the Wall Street Journal.
payoff: The US fleet remains larger by tonnage, at roughly 290 ships.
